summary.text: On Ravnica, the guilds turn on each other and monsters ravage the city around the Guildpact's Decamillennial, revealing that the chaos was calculated.
Szadek attacks Vitu-Ghazi and feeds on Mat'Selesnya until Fonn revives the Chorus, and Agrus Kos arrests him, which breaks the Guildpact and exposes House Dimir.
Meanwhile Izolda's Rakdos cultists use Myc's blood to rouse Rakdos, and Rakdos and Project Kraj fight to a draw, while the Parhelion crashes into Prahv.
